question: ΔABC and ΔDEF are congruent respectively. If AB = 6 = DE, BC = 8 = EF and m ∠B = 30°, then m ∠D + m ∠C = __ __ .
solution:
Given:

ΔABC and ΔDEF are congruent respectively. 

AB = 6 = DE, BC = 8 = EF and m ∠B = 30°

Concept used:

1. SAS Congruency: If two sides and the included angle of one triangle are equal to two sides and included angle of another triangle, then the triangles are congruent. E.g.: if ∠A = ∠X and AB/XY = AC/XZ then ΔABC ≅ ΔXYZ.

From the congruency, 

AB/XY = BC/YZ = AC/XZ

and ∠B = ∠Y and ∠C = ∠Z

2. The three interior angles of a triangle will always have a sum of 180°.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b260f67f751e5db4e9f5c34668912ac09fda2ab241783a7ac7d7ef81e61aff55.png] 

​According to the concept,

Since ΔABC and ΔDEF are congruent and AB = 6 = DE, BC = 8 = EF and m ∠B = 30°, m ∠B = m ∠E = 30°.

Also, m ∠C = m ∠F ....(1)

Hence, m ∠A = m ∠D ....(2)

​According to the concept,

m ∠C + m ∠A = (180 - 30)° ....(3)

m ∠E + m ∠F = (180 - 30)° ....(4)

From 1, 2, 3 and 4,

m ∠D + m ∠C = (180 - 30)° 

⇒ m ∠D + m ∠C = 150° 

**∴ The value of m ∠D + m ∠C is 150°.**
